ios.desc:
Swiftly Workspace runs your business from your iPhone and iPad: customers, invoices, payments, projects and time tracking in one place, with an AI assistant built into every screen rather than bolted on as a separate chatbot.

AI THAT WORKS ON YOUR OWN DATA
Ask questions in plain language and get answers drawn from your actual records, not generic advice.
Open the assistant inside any record and it already has the context of what you are looking at.
Creating a customer, invoice or project? Describe what you need and the assistant fills the form, so you review and correct instead of typing from scratch.
Dictate with your voice instead of tapping.
Bring your own AI provider: connect your own API key from any supported provider, or use Apple Intelligence on device.

CUSTOMERS AND SUPPLIERS
Keep customers, suppliers, contacts and addresses together. VAT numbers are checked against the EU VIES service and email addresses are validated, so bad data is caught before it reaches an invoice.

INVOICING AND PAYMENTS
Issue invoices, credit notes and proformas on both the customer and supplier side. Record payments and allocate them across documents. Manage SEPA direct debit mandates.

EUROPEAN E-INVOICING
Send and receive PEPPOL BIS 3 electronic invoices. Incoming documents are parsed, scored for confidence and can be imported automatically once you trust the match. Sending and receiving are switched on independently.

PROJECTS AND TIME
Plan work as phases, work packages and tasks with the people assigned to each. Track time against projects and route it through approval workflows, with required approvers set per project.

BUILT FOR CONTROL
Roles and per-field permissions decide exactly who can see and change what.
Whole modules can be switched on or off per company, so people only see the parts they use.
Configure which fields appear, which are required and what they default to, without waiting for a release.
Change history records who changed which field, from what value, and when.
Import existing data from CSV or Excel with AI-assisted column mapping, and export back to CSV.

DESIGNED FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Native SwiftUI throughout. On iPad a three-column layout puts your workspace, list and record on screen at once. Home Screen quick actions and App Intents let you start a new record without opening the app first. VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and Increased Contrast are supported as core features, not afterthoughts.

FOR TEAMS
Single sign-on and SCIM provisioning connect

quotes.text:
TL;DR: Built an ERP where AI agents execute workflows like procurement and invoice processing. Uses Cases (workspaces) and Tasks (sessions) like Claude Code. Agent completes one task, automatically triggers the next. Mac app live, looking for early users.

Mac App: https://apps.apple.com/be/app/swiftly-ai-native-erp/id6755155607?mt=12

TestFlight: https://testflight.apple.com/join/aYc16FmA

THE PROBLEM

After 8 years implementing ERPs across Europe, I kept seeing the same issue: ERP systems store data but can't execute processes. Employees still manually click through forms for invoicing, procurement, onboarding.

WHAT WE BUILT

AI agents that execute multi-step business workflows autonomously.

Example: Vendor Procurement

  Case: "Source Steel Pipes - Q1 2026"
  
  Task 1: Research Suppliers → finds 3 vendors
  Task 2: Compare Pricing → creates comparison
  Task 3: Negotiate → drafts proposal, waits for approval
  Task 4: Create PO → auto-triggered after approval

Each task has specific instructions. Status changes trigger next tasks. You approve key decisions. Everything is auditable.

HOW IT'S DIFFERENT

Workflow engines (Zapier): Rigid rules that break
RPA tools: Brittle scripts
AI chatbots: Just answer questions

Swiftly: End-to-end execution with approval gates

WHAT'S INCLUDED

Full ERP/CRM underneath: AP/AR, Projects, Time Tracking, Contracts, Inventory, Customer Management. The AI workflow layer sits on top.

Tech: SwiftUI apps, Swift/Vapor backend, PostgreSQL, …
